verses.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
verses.pt: Ora, Moisés estava apascentando o rebanho de Jetro, seu sogro, sacerdote de Midiã; e levou o rebanho para trás do deserto, e chegou a Horebe, o monte de Deus.
verses.en_web: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.
verses.en_bbe: Now Moses was looking after the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian: and he took the flock to the back of the waste land and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.pt: E apareceu-lhe o anjo do Senhor em uma chama de fogo do meio duma sarça. Moisés olhou, e eis que a sarça ardia no fogo, e a sarça não se consumia;
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
verses.en_bbe: And the angel of the Lord was seen by him in a flame of fire coming out of a thorn-tree: and he saw that the tree was on fire, but it was not burned up.

verses.en: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
verses.pt: pelo que disse: Agora me virarei para lá e verei esta maravilha, e por que a sarça não se queima.
verses.en_web: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said, I will go and see this strange thing, why the tree is not burned up,

verses.en: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
verses.pt: E vendo o Senhor que ele se virara para ver, chamou-o do meio da sarça, e disse: Moisés, Moisés! Respondeu ele: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the Lord saw him turning to one side to see, God said his name out of the tree, crying, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
verses.pt: Prosseguiu Deus: Não te chegues para cá; tira os sapatos dos pés; porque o lugar em que tu estás é terra santa.
verses.en_web: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Do not come near: take off your shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.

verses.en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
verses.pt: Disse mais: Eu sou o Deus de teu pai, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó. E Moisés escondeu o rosto, porque temeu olhar para Deus.
verses.en_web: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look at God.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses kept his face covered for fear of looking on God.

verses.en: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor: Com efeito tenho visto a aflição do meu povo, que está no Egito, e tenho ouvido o seu clamor por causa dos seus exatores, porque conheço os seus sofrimentos;
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.
verses.en_bbe: And God said, Truly, I have seen the grief of my people in Egypt, and their cry because of their cruel masters has come to my ears; for I have knowledge of their sorrows;

verses.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
verses.pt: e desci para o livrar da mão dos egípcios, e para o fazer subir daquela terra para uma terra boa e espaçosa, para uma terra que mana leite e mel; para o lugar do cananeu, do heteu, do amorreu, do perizeu, do heveu e do jebuseu.
verses.en_web: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.en_bbe: And I have come down to take them out of the hands of the Egyptians, guiding them out of that land into a good land and wide, into a land flowing with milk and honey; into the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.pt: E agora, ei s que o clamor dos filhos de Israel é vindo a mim; e também tenho visto a opressão com que os egípcios os oprimem.
verses.en_web: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.
verses.en_bbe: For now, truly, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me, and I have seen the cruel behaviour of the Egyptians to them.

verses.en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, vem e eu te enviarei a Faraó, para que tireis do Egito o meu povo, os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
verses.en_bbe: Come, then, and I will send you to Pharaoh, so that you may take my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.

verses.en: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
verses.pt: Então Moisés disse a Deus: Quem sou eu, para que vá a Faraó e tire do Egito os filhos de Israel?
verses.en_web: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to God, Who am I to go to Pharaoh and take the children of Israel out of Egypt?

verses.en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Deus: Certamente eu serei contigo; e isto te será por sinal de que eu te enviei: Quando houveres tirado do Egito o meu povo, servireis a Deus neste monte.
verses.en_web: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Truly I will be with you; and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: when you have taken the children of Israel out of Egypt, you will give worship to God on this mountain.

verses.en: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
verses.pt: Então disse Moisés a Deus: Eis que quando eu for aos filhos de Israel, e lhes disser: O Deus de vossos pais me enviou a vós; e eles me perguntarem: Qual é o seu nome? Que lhes direi?
verses.en_web: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you;’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ What should I tell them?”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to God, When I come to the children of Israel and say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you: and they say to me, What is his name? what am I to say to them?

verses.en: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
verses.pt: Respondeu Deus a Moisés: EU SOU O QUE SOU. Disse mais: Assim dirás aos olhos de Israel: EU SOU me enviou a vós.
verses.en_web: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: And God said to him, I AM WHAT I AM: and he said, Say to the children of Israel, I AM has sent me to you.

verses.en: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
verses.pt: E Deus disse mais a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: O Senhor, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó, me enviou a vós; este é o meu nome eternamente, e este é o meu memorial de geração em geração.
verses.en_web: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.
verses.en_bbe: And God went on to say to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has sent me to you: this is my name for ever, and this is my sign to all generations.

verses.en: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
verses.pt: Vai, ajunta os anciãos de Israel e dize-lhes: O Senhor, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Jacó, apareceu-me, dizendo: certamente vos tenho visitado e visto o que vos tem sido feito no Egito;
verses.en_web: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt;
verses.en_bbe: Go and get together the chiefs of the children of Israel, and say to them, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by me, and has said, Truly I have taken up your cause, because of what is done to you in Egypt;

verses.en: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.pt: e tenho dito: Far-vos-ei subir da aflição do Egito para a terra do cananeu, do heteu, do amorreu, do perizeu, do heveu e do jebuseu, para uma terra que mana leite e mel.
verses.en_web: and I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’
verses.en_bbe: And I have said, I will take you up out of the sorrows of Egypt into the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, into a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
verses.pt: E ouvirão a tua voz; e ireis, tu e os anciãos de Israel, ao rei do Egito, e dir-lhe-eis: O Senhor, o Deus dos hebreus, encontrou-nos. Agora, pois, deixa-nos ir caminho de três dias para o deserto para que ofereçamos sacrifícios ao Senhor nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: They will listen to your voice, and you shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’
verses.en_bbe: And they will give ear to your voice: and you, with the chiefs of Israel, will go to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and say to him, The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God.

verses.en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.pt: Eu sei, porém, que o rei do Egito não vos deixará ir, a não ser por uma forte mão.
verses.en_web: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.
verses.en_bbe: And I am certain that the king of Egypt will not let you go without being forced.

verses.en: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
verses.pt: Portanto estenderei a minha mão, e ferirei o Egito com todas as minhas maravilhas que farei no meio dele. Depois vos deixará ir.
verses.en_web: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
verses.en_bbe: But I will put out my hand and overcome Egypt with all the wonders which I will do among them: and after that he will let you go.

verses.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
verses.pt: E eu darei graça a este povo aos olhos dos egípcios; e acontecerá que, quando sairdes, não saireis vazios.
verses.en_web: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.
verses.en_bbe: And I will give this people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians, so that when you go out you will go out with your hands full.

verses.en: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
verses.pt: Porque cada mulher pedirá à sua vizinha e à sua hóspeda jóias de prata e jóias de ouro, bem como vestidos, os quais poreis sobre vossos filhos e sobre vossas filhas; assim despojareis os egípcios.
verses.en_web: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing; and you shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”
verses.en_bbe: For every woman will get from her neighbour and from the woman living in her house, ornaments of silver and gold, and clothing; and you will put them on your sons and your daughters; you will take the best of their goods from the Egyptians.
